_comment: ADR 0049 — engine_rules lib bundle. Auto-loaded by WorldBoot before any per-game rules. Expresses what used to be hardcoded engine scans as the same primitive rules content authors write. Lifetime primitive: entities with state.lifetime: N (in ticks) decrement by 1 each sim-tick and despawn when they hit zero. Used by transient entities (bullets, particles, damage numbers).

rules._comment: Decrement step. Fires only for entities WITH state.lifetime > 0 — entities without the field are unaffected (non-transient). Tick-discrete: integer ticks, not seconds, for save-state reproducibility.

Despawn step. Fires when an entity's lifetime hits zero. Ordered AFTER the decrement so same-tick (decrement to 0 → despawn) works in one pass. Despawn routes through the spawn manager's standard cleanup (relations + spatial index + physics body + queue_free).
